2609.05099.title: Improving Language Identification for Code-Switched Utterances with Integer Linear Programming
2609.05099.paper_summary: Automatic identification of code-switched (CS) utterances remains a challenge for language identification (LID) systems, causing such texts to be underrepresented in the training data of Large Language Models. In this paper, we revisit MaskLID, a state-of-the art approach for CS identification, which requires no training and detects arbitrary language combinations. We make three main contributions: (a) we reveal, and address, a major issue of MaskLID: its overreliance on word-level language association scores; (b) we reformulate the underlying optimization algorithm as an Integer Linear Program, enabling us to experiment with a large set of clear and interpretable constraints; (c) each of these improvements vastly improves the baseline system, as we illustrate in experiments involving 10~diverse languages, where we observe a strong boost in performance on CS benchmarks. We release our code and data for reproducibility.
2609.05099.paper_summary_zh: 自動識別語碼切換（CS）發言對於語言識別（LID）系統仍然是一個挑戰，導致這類文本在大型語言模型的訓練數據中被低估。在本文中，我們重新探討了MaskLID，這是一種最先進的CS識別方法，無需訓練並能檢測任意語言組合。我們做出了三個主要貢獻：（a）我們揭示並解決了MaskLID的一個主要問題：過度依賴單詞級別的語言關聯分數；（b）我們將基礎優化算法重新表述為整數線性規劃，使我們能夠實驗一組清晰且可解釋的約束條件；（c）這些改進大幅提升了基線系統的性能，我們在涉及10種多樣語言的實驗中展示了這一點，在CS基準測試中觀察到了性能的顯著提升。我們釋放了我們的代碼和數據以便於重現。
